## Aykut C. Satici {.unlisted .unnumbered}

[Associate Professor of Systems Engineering]{.profile-role}

Erik Jonsson School of Engineering and Computer Science\
The University of Texas at Dallas

I lead the [Robot Control Lab](people/index.qmd). My research brings together robotics, nonlinear control, and machine learning, using mathematical models, optimization, and learning to study locomotion and manipulation.

Before joining UT Dallas in January 2026, I was a faculty member at Boise State University and a postdoctoral researcher at MIT and the University of Naples Federico II.
